title: Mystery scoring
subtitle: Your default points and penalties for Mystery games, by age and by scenario.
intro: These values replace the Mystery scenarios' own values on your playgrounds (at the next sync). An empty field keeps the scenario's value. Right/wrong answer points apply to every enigma.
precedence: Priority: scenario value below > age value > value set in the scenario. The age used is the scenario's youngest band.
notMigrated: Not available on this server yet (migration pending).
byAgeHint: Default values based on the scenario's age band.
byScenarioHint: Overrides the age value for one scenario. Greyed text shows what applies when the field is left empty.

fields.malus_both_answers_biped: Penalty when both answers are punched
